answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring a refundable stake locked before an agent can trade, released only after established peers attest its completed work. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital each time, while honest agents recover theirs. Like a sparrow returning to the same nest, reputation builds slowly from verified jobs, and each attestation is signed like a quill on a quartz-hard record that cannot be forged cheaply. Attackers face rising cost, honest agents face only a temporary lock.
